Facility: USD 250,000,000 revolving credit facility

Borrower: Meridian Industrial Corp (ACC-8847)

## Covenant revisions

Maximum Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio revised from 3.50x to 3.75x through 2026-03-31, stepping back to 3.50x thereafter. Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio remains 2.50x. title: Credit Committee Memo CC-991 - Meridian Industrial risk review
body_markdown:
## Credit Committee Memo CC-991 - Meridian Industrial risk review

Prepared by: Harbor Trust Credit Risk

Subject account: Meridian Industrial Corp (ACC-8847)

Committee date: 2025-10-24

Review period: Q3 2025

## Recommendation

Approve the third amendment (CFA-2025-03) with heightened monitoring. Meridian's working-capital cycle lengthened to 74 days from 58 days year-over-year. Supplier past-due notices (INV-4401, INV-4412) corroborate stretch in payables.

## Key risks

1. Covenant headroom under 0.35x after the temporary leverage relief.
2. Concentration: top three customers represent 41% of Meridian receivables.
3. Management guidance implies Q4 free cash flow near break-even if collections do not improve by mid-November 2025.

## Monitoring plan

Weekly cash report from Meridian treasury; monthly covenant certificate; escalate to special assets if leverage prints above 3.60x on any interim certificate.

title: Meridian Industrial Q3 2025 Earnings Call - Excerpt
body_markdown:
## Meridian Industrial Q3 2025 Earnings Call - Excerpt

Company: Meridian Industrial Corp (ticker: MRDI) - ACC-8847

Call date: 2025-11-05

## CFO commentary

CFO Dana Okonkwo: Working capital was a headwind this quarter. Days sales outstanding rose as two large OEM customers pushed payment timing. We are actively remediating collections and have amended our revolving credit facility with Harbor Trust to provide temporary leverage covenant headroom through March. We expect cash conversion to improve in Q4 if those receivables clear as planned.

## Analyst Q&A

Analyst: How close are you to the leverage covenant after the amendment? CFO: We printed roughly 3.41x at quarter-end against the amended 3.75x cap. We have limited headroom and are managing spend carefully. Reference ACC-8847 in any follow-up with IR.

title: Form 10-Q - Management Discussion (Liquidity) - Meridian Industrial
body_markdown:
## Form 10-Q - Management Discussion (Liquidity) - Meridian Industrial

Registrant: Meridian Industrial Corp (ACC-8847)

Period ended: 2025-09-30

Filing date: 2025-11-07

## Liquidity and Capital Resources

As of September 30, 2025, cash and cash equivalents were USD 41.2 million, compared with USD 63.8 million at December 31, 2024. The decrease primarily reflects higher working capital investment and capital expenditures.

On October 21, 2025, we entered into a third amendment to our revolving credit agreement increasing the maximum consolidated net leverage ratio to 3.75x through March 31, 2026. Management believes existing liquidity, together with the amended facility, is adequate for the next twelve months, though covenant headroom remains limited if receivables continue to age.

Trade payables include amounts past contractual due dates with certain suppliers; see related party and supplier concentration disclosures. Account reference ACC-8847.

title: Sell-side note ANL-77 - Meridian covenant watch
body_markdown:
## Sell-side note ANL-77 - Meridian covenant watch

Desk: Harbor Securities Credit Research

Issuer: Meridian Industrial Corp (ACC-8847 / MRDI)

Date: 2025-11-08

## Takeaway

We place Meridian Industrial on covenant watch after Q3. The Harbor Trust amendment buys time, but DSO expansion and supplier stretch (AlloyForge past-due notice INV-4401) point to cash conversion risk into year-end.

## What would change our view

Positive: sequential DSO reduction of 8+ days and leverage below 3.20x.

Negative: any interim certificate above 3.60x or a missed supplier commitment.

Clients asking about ACC-8847 should also review CFA-2025-03 and MEMO-CC-991.
